answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose that reasoning skills, such as numerical reasoning, are amenable to automatic data generation. Hence, one can inject that skill directly into the model by adding additional pre-training steps, allowing the model to learn the skill in an end-to-end fashion.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates answers that are either spans from the input or numbers computed token-by-token during decoding.

answer_2.quote: We report results of GEN-BERT initialized by BERT-base and leave pretraining a larger model for future work. We compare GENBERT to MTMSN  initialized with BERT-base, as MTMSN initialized with BERT-large is a state-of-the-art model on DROP.
